# meshmsg v0.1.20

This release establishes a lean, single-version local IPC boundary.

## Changes

- Requires strict local IPC protocol version 2 envelopes.
- Keeps one ordinary status response and removes diagnostic-status negotiation and telemetry responses.
- Removes capability preflights between current CLI, web, and daemon components.
- Retains bounded internal diagnostics without exposing them as protocol state.

## Compatibility

There are no message-wire or persistent-state format changes in this release. Local IPC is intentionally breaking: clients and daemons must both use protocol version 2 and are not negotiated or downgraded.

Install this exact source release after the `v0.1.20` tag is published:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.20 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.19...v0.1.20
